comments: Maybe you can try using my plugin https://www.npmjs.com/package/vite-plugin-public-path
During the build process, vite will collect resource urls to generate `[name].[hash].[ext]` files

> 也许您可以尝试使用我的插件https://www.npmjs.com/package/vite-plugin-public-path

你的实现是在 generateBundle 实现的 这个错误在 resolveId 之后就出现异常了

@menkeydyvh 用我的插件的话，你需要去掉 `{{cdnHost}}`，把这些资源都按照 Vite 的本地引用格式来写，然后在 `<head>` 里写一段脚本，在客户端动态给 `window.publicPath` 赋值，`window.publicPath` 的值应该等于你 `{{cdnHost}}` 的值（记得加上 `/` 结尾）。

不过有个问题是，我的插件是对全站所有资源生效的，如果只希望一部分走 CDN 的话就不适用了。

review_comments:
I'm still unsure about the order change in the JS that this is going to produce. IIUC, before if the user had first the CSS styles, these were the first imports in the JS, and now they will be imported at the end after all other JS tags. I wonder if we should mark the JS position by adding something like
```
  js += `${STYLE_IMPORT_MARKER_}${styleUrlId}`
```
And then we can replace it by `\nimport ...` or by `` depending on the result of the URL resolution.
